annotations.exact_quote: Deep graph clustering, as a fundamental task in data mining, has attracted widespread attention.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确将深度图聚类作为研究任务，并提出MTASCN框架以可学习表示获得聚类划分，符合深度聚类定义。

annotations.exact_quote: integrating graph structure and node attributes to generate consensus latent embeddings
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要将图结构与节点属性作为互补信息源并联合生成共识潜嵌入，属于多视图数据设定与联合利用。

annotations.exact_quote: Structure-oriented Multi-order Loss Module (SMLM) that reinforces the generation of clustering distribution under reliable structure information guidance by calculating the multi-order similarity between the latent embeddings and the original graph structure
annotations.reason_zh: SMLM利用原始图结构计算潜嵌入与图结构的多阶相似度，以结构一致性引导聚类分布生成，符合图/流形正则化。

abstentions.reason_zh: 摘要提到深度图聚类框架与图结构/节点属性生成潜嵌入，但未明确使用图卷积或图上可学习消息传递，无法确认GNN机制。
